exposure: Obstetric complications (OCs) evaluated with the Lewis-Murray Scale
OCs related with abnormal fetal growth
cohort: The study participants were 101 chronic schizophrenia patients.
finding: Obstetric complications related to abnormal fetal growth and OCs during gestation were associated with lower birth weight, while difficulties in delivery, complications in pregnancy, or OCs as a homogeneous group were not.
mod_finding: Difficulties in delivery, as a pattern of obstetric complications, were not associated with birth weight.
cross-section timing: Data on historical obstetric complications and birth weight was collected for chronic schizophrenia patients at the time of the study.
